assumptions.capacityNote: Capacity model at this site's mean 25°C: LFP 100%, sodium-ion 85% (LFP voltage settings), lead-acid (AGM) about 85% (cold derating where applicable).
assumptions.money: Auto mode sizes sodium-ion and LFP to deliver the same bill cut within its depth-of-discharge window (sodium modeled on LFP voltage settings — slightly less capacity, gentler discharge). The 10/15/20% peak-offset matrix columns are fixed reference points; the "your target" column follows the 1–150% slider and is sized by an exact engine run. Lifetime cost adds every bank swap PLUS install labor each time over 20 years; lead-acid is modeled WITHOUT active balancing (typical DIY strings) and shown only as a savings reference, never recommended. Payback compares first cost against bill savings; fixed connection fees not counted.
